title: Bank OZK Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Bank OZK amid liquidity and crypto transitions.
coverage_note: Full text read, including distributional macro, Japan, on-chain data, identity/stablecoins and the bank credit deep dive.

claims.claim: Policy guards a systemic liquidity floor.
claims.reason: The $5.8 tn floor needs the exact proxy and sampling convention. Nearby public-component reconstructions below that level would be adverse, but using a different TGA convention can change the result.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.
claims.next_check: Reconstruct the original daily liquidity definition and test all lows.

claims.reason: QT was already announced to slow; the genuinely forward component, new purchases during 2025, occurred in December. Avoid counting the known taper as a forecast.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

evidence.title: Changes to balance sheet reduction
evidence.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
evidence.finding: Effective June 1, Treasury runoff cap fell from $60 billion to $25 billion monthly; agency cap remained $35 billion.

evidence.title: Reserve management purchases
evidence.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
evidence.finding: The Desk announced $40 billion of initial bill purchases starting December 12, to maintain ample reserves. This is not itself evidence of deficit monetization as the causal motive.

claims.reason: U.S. money growth is insufficient for the exact global aggregate; exchange-rate conversion can drive measured global money independently of local creation.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.
claims.next_check: Rebuild the source global-M2 basket in local currencies and USD.

claims.claim: Consumer sentiment diverges from aggregate output.

claims.claim: Fiscal flows favor wealthy older consumers.

claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.
claims.next_check: Link household age/wealth/interest income with spending changes.

claims.claim: Macro chatter may mark cycle exhaustion.
claims.reason: An anecdotal attention indicator has no defined sample, trigger or predictive scoring rule.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

claims.claim: Japan intervention slows one-way carry trades.
claims.reason: Official dollar sales occurred. Their effect on carry positioning and durability is separate; repeated intervention is not proof of a lasting yen floor.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

evidence.finding: Japan bought yen and sold dollars on April 29 and May 1, totaling 9,788.5 billion yen.

claims.claim: Dencun reduces burn and raises issuance.
claims.reason: Independent on-chain analysis confirms reduced fee burn after Dencun and a shift back to net inflation. The precise claim concerns net supply growth; Dencun did not simply raise the gross validator reward schedule.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

evidence.title: Ethereum issuance and burn analysis
evidence.finding: 2025 report with data through May: net post-Merge supply change bottomed at about -427,000 ETH in March 2024; lower fee pressure after Dencun plus lighter demand reduced burn, leaving cumulative net supply about +294,000 ETH. Lower burn raises net issuance, not necessarily the gross validator issuance schedule.

evidence.title: Dencun upgrade specification
evidence.finding: Introduced temporary blobs through EIP-4844 to reduce rollup transaction fees; scheduled March 13, 2024.

claims.claim: Supply scarcity alone cannot establish value.
claims.reason: A supply rule does not create demand. The stronger claim linking all frequent hard forks to centralization would require a governance measure and is not established.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Narrow deductive identity only; no empirical forecasting credit.

claims.claim: Stablecoin expansion leaves chain winners uncertain.

claims.claim: New projects avoid legacy property mismatch.
claims.reason: Construction lending does not logically eliminate collateral mismatch, and subsequent RESG losses establish meaningful property risk. However, the retrieved filings do not identify origination/underwriting dates for these specific loans. Losses on pre-pandemic credits would not by themselves refute the narrower claim about new loans underwritten at current rates. The broad portfolio inference requires vintage analysis.

framework_lessons: Inspect loan structure before sector labels.
assessment: OZK continued earning substantial profits but later incurred material property losses. Those losses challenge a broad impression of immunity; missing loan-vintage details prevent a clean refutation of the new-underwriting argument. The equity horizon remains open. The 2025 Fed balance-sheet turn was correctly anticipated.
verification_limitations: Current snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date vintage.
Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
